src/rendering/ui/cartridges/classic/clas.responsibility: Registers the Preact Classic / Sci-Fi CartridgeUIDefinition (ConsoleModalHost Master Dossier, commands, helpSections, hotbar wiring) without forced theme overrides.

ownershipBoundary.includes: Preact Classic Cartridge UI registration and Master Dossier modal wrapper.
ownershipBoundary.excludes: Headless Classic UI data projection (owned by src/rulesets/classic/ui/classic_ui_adapter.ts).

antiPatterns: Do not couple Classic Cartridge modals to legacy #dnd35e-sheet-overlay DOM elements or force a global theme override.

src/rulesets/classic/classic_combat.ts.responsibility: Resolves Classic roguelike melee combat exchanges, defense reduction, faction hostility penalties, and lethal damage application.

ownershipBoundary.includes: Coordinating facade and primary orchestration exports declared directly in src/rulesets/classic/classic_combat.ts.
ownershipBoundary.excludes: Underlying primitive symbols re-exported from leaf modules (e.g. src/systems/damage.system.ts).

antiPatterns: Do not duplicate or bypass exports from src/rulesets/classic/classic_combat.ts.

src/rulesets/classic/classic_ruleset.ts.responsibility: The canonical `classic` ruleset cartridge encapsulating Milestones 1–81 mechanics.

ownershipBoundary.includes: Pure implementation and exports for src/rulesets/classic/classic_ruleset.ts.
ownershipBoundary.excludes: External state mutation or unrelated subsystem logic.

antiPatterns: Do not duplicate or bypass exports from src/rulesets/classic/classic_ruleset.ts.

src/rulesets/classic/classic_stats.ts.responsibility: Computes Classic effective combat stats, projects HUD vitals, and resolves XP/level advancement.

ownershipBoundary.includes: Pure implementation and exports for src/rulesets/classic/classic_stats.ts.
ownershipBoundary.excludes: External state mutation or unrelated subsystem logic.

antiPatterns: Do not duplicate or bypass exports from src/rulesets/classic/classic_stats.ts.

src/rulesets/classic/classic_validator.t.responsibility: Validates Classic roguelike ruleset invariants for a campaign.

ownershipBoundary.excludes: External state mutation or unrelated subsystem logic.

antiPatterns: Do not duplicate or bypass exports from src/rulesets/classic/classic_validator.ts.

src/rulesets/classic/ui/classic_ui_adapt.responsibility: Projects Classic / Sci-Fi ECS state into the unified Tier 1 Console UI models (Character Sheet, Inventory, Hotbar).

ownershipBoundary.excludes: DOM manipulation or direct modal registration (owned by src/rendering/ui/classic_ui_registration.ts).

antiPatterns: Do not duplicate or bypass exports from src/rulesets/classic/ui/classic_ui_adapter.ts.
